boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, no-cost ways to spend time together through Sewanee’s outing program, arts spaces, and public lectures.

cards.title: Take a weekly SOP hike
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Check the SOP’s current weekday outing plan, then join a group hike and use the program’s gear rather than buying your own.
cards.short_summary: A guided, gear-supported way for Sewanee students to explore the Domain on foot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program lists hiking among its weekday activities and states that weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; check the program’s current outing details before going.

cards.title: Run trails with the SOP
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Look for a trail-running outing, bring water and suitable shoes, and follow the trip leader’s route and pace guidance.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost student group run on the University’s trail network.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program includes trail running among its weekday activities and says weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; participate only through the listed outing and follow leader instructions.

cards.title: Ride single-track with the SOP
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Join a scheduled mountain-biking outing, confirm the route conditions, and ride within the group’s stated skill expectations.
cards.short_summary: A free student outing built around the Domain’s single-track trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program lists mountain biking among its weekday activities and states that weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; confirm current trip details and required safety guidance.

cards.title: Try an SOP climbing outing
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Sign up for a scheduled climbing trip so the group can use SOP gear and follow the leader’s safety setup at the site.
cards.short_summary: A supervised student climbing option using the Domain’s established climbing areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program offers rock-climbing activities, owns required trip gear, and says weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; use only the program’s supervised setup and instructions.

cards.title: Boulder with the SOP
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Choose a scheduled bouldering outing, use the program’s available equipment, and follow the leader’s site and safety guidance.
cards.short_summary: A free student group activity at Sewanee’s outdoor bouldering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program lists bouldering among its weekday activities and says it owns required gear; weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; attend the listed outing and follow all safety direction.

cards.title: Paddle on a weekly SOP trip
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Watch the weekly outing schedule for a canoeing trip, arrive prepared for outdoor conditions, and use the program’s provided gear.
cards.short_summary: A group paddling activity offered without charge to Sewanee students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program lists canoeing among its weekday activities, owns required trip gear, and says weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; review the trip listing for location and safety requirements.

cards.title: Join an SOP caving outing
cards.subtitle: Sewanee Outing Program • The Domain
cards.notes: Go only with the scheduled SOP group, use the provided equipment, and follow the trip leader’s route, protective-gear, and safety rules.
cards.short_summary: A program-led student caving activity that does not require purchasing gear.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sewanee Outing Program lists caving among its weekday activities, owns required trip gear, and says weekly SOP trips are free to all students.
cards.source_title: Weekly Outings | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Free to Sewanee students as a weekly SOP trip; only join the program-led outing and comply with all safety requirements.

cards.title: See “Dark Waters” at the University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: University Art Gallery • Sewanee campus
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit after the exhibition opens on Aug. 26, then pair it with a conversation about the photographs and film work.
cards.short_summary: A public gallery visit centered on Kristine Potter’s exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Art Gallery’s 2026–27 season page says Kristine Potter’s “Dark Waters” opens Aug. 26, 2026, and identifies the exhibition and related events as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibition | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: The exhibition opens Aug. 26, 2026; the University describes it as free and open to the public.

cards.title: Attend the “Dark Waters” artist talk
cards.subtitle: Guerry Auditorium • Sept. 17, 2026
cards.notes: Meet at Guerry Auditorium for Kristine Potter’s talk, then discuss how the exhibition connects photographs, film, landscape, and memory.
cards.short_summary: A free public artist talk connected to the University Art Gallery’s fall exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Art Gallery schedules Kristine Potter to speak about “Dark Waters” on Sept. 17, 2026, in Guerry Auditorium and says the event is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibition | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Sept. 17, 2026; the University identifies the event as free and open to the public.

cards.title: Go to the St. Luke’s Lectures
cards.subtitle: School of Theology • Oct. 7, 2026
cards.notes: Attend one or more lectures in the series, take notes on the art-and-scripture themes, and continue the conversation afterward.
cards.short_summary: A three-lecture public series hosted by Sewanee’s School of Theology.
cards.evidence_claim: The School of Theology states that the 2026 St. Luke’s Lectures series, scheduled for Oct. 7, is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: 2026 St. Luke’s Lectures & Homecoming | School of Theology
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for Oct. 7, 2026; the School of Theology states the lecture series is free and open to the public.
